validation.attribution: One input moved and everything follows. A live arc centre makes the arc cost finite, so all sixty slot totals are ordered and 009E7BFA can take a new incumbent: the winner stops being the seed and ranges over the ring. The published heading settles instead of flapping, which is why heading changes fall by a third to a half rather than rising. That heading feeds 009E6A90's throttle limiter, so the ships' speeds and tracks differ and the gunnery census follows: 19 more shots, 6 more hull hits, 1210 more damage, the same three deaths. Standoff ranges are curve outputs and do not move; the committed slots are sampled first and last only and match at those two instants.
